desc: Own a piece of history, without the expensive price tag. The Mauser MP-40 comes in a cost-effective .22 rimfire package! Manufactured as a rifle with no stock, this replica classic firearm is the closest version of an MP-40 available on the market today. While maintaining a very close overall appearance to the original WWII firearm, the MAUSER-MP40 is manufactured with undeniable attention to detail, and quality craftsmanship.
